title: Malformed input response contract
description: The source specifies usage and operational exit codes, while malformed and duplicate log lines must be skipped without failing. A particular diagnostic wording is not prescribed; use one warning line per skipped nonblank input line and a single diagnostic line for command-level failures.

options.label: Conventional exit codes and concise diagnostics

system_choice: Use exit code 2 for malformed invocations, exit code 1 for unreadable logs, and exit code 0 when processing succeeds despite skipped lines. Write concise diagnostics to standard error and no standard output on command-level errors.
